body:
Just wanted to write up a quick report. Insufflated 25mg methoxetamine that I acquired from years ago before it was scheduled. Was resting safely in a cool storage box. +120 minutes and all I got was a headache and slightly elevated blood pressure. Seems as if I took maybe 100mg DXM (dextromethorphan). Better luck next time?
